summary.headline: RailTel Q1 FY27 operating revenue rose 20% YoY to INR893 crores, with orders received of INR1,688 crores versus INR721 crores a year earlier.
summary.overview: Operating revenue was INR893 crores against INR744 crores in Q1 FY26, and total revenue was INR910 crores against INR758 crores. PBT before exceptional items rose 12% to INR96 crores, while reported PBT (INR89 crores) and PAT (INR66 crores) were broadly flat YoY. Management attributed the flat reported profit to a non-cash ECL provision booked as an exceptional item, and said the provision can reverse when payments are received. Order book stood at INR11,747 crores as of the call date, and the company expects INR3,500 crores of project income in FY27.

segments.name: NLD (telecom)
segments.commentary: Revenue INR144 crores vs INR151 crores a year ago, turning negative YoY. Management said government renewals are pending and billing follows PO issuance; NIC decentralised ordering to individual institutes. New customers include Air Force, a private operator and Starlink.

segments.name: ISP (RailWire)
segments.commentary: Revenue INR112 crores. RailWire subscribers reached 6.23 lakh, up about 50,000 YoY, but ARPU is under pressure from broadband competition.

segments.name: IP-1 (telecom)
segments.commentary: Revenue INR27 crores in the quarter.

segments.name: Project business
segments.commentary: Revenue INR532 crores in Q1. Project margins were said to be sustained at 4-5%, with some sequential improvement in Q1. Railways account for about 23-23.5% of the total order book.

guidance_outlook: Project income guidance of about INR3,500 crores for FY27 (management said 'minimum' and 'anticipated', noting it was not fully certain).
Management maintained its earlier outlook for growth of about 25% in revenue.
Kavach revenue recognition expected to begin in FY27, with RDSO approval for the East Central Railway order expected next month and approval for the new OEM (Quadrant Future) expected this month.
Kavach margins expected to be slightly better than the current project margin range.
Data center revenue expected around INR300 crores in FY27 and around INR500 crores in FY28-29.
10 MW Noida data center targeted by May 2027, possibly a month earlier.

qa_highlights.question: Breakup of revenue across NLD, ISP and IP-1 segments?
qa_highlights.answer: IP-1 INR27 crores, ISP INR112 crores, NLD INR144 crores in Q1 FY27.

qa_highlights.question: Kavach execution status and expected tenders this year?
qa_highlights.answer: Outdoor work is advanced in East Central Railway and started in West Central Railway; RDSO approval expected next month. Few Kavach tenders expected this year as existing awarded orders are under execution. Management expects Kavach revenue recognition to start this year.

qa_highlights.question: Why did NLD decline YoY and turn negative?
qa_highlights.answer: Government renewals were pending, so billing awaited POs; NIC decentralised ordering to institutes, which asked services not be discontinued. Management said there is nothing to worry about in NLD, with new customers Air Force, a private operator and Starlink.

qa_highlights.question: Why is ISP growth muted, and is FWA competition affecting it?
qa_highlights.answer: RailWire added about 50,000 subscribers YoY to 6.23 lakh, but ARPU is under pressure from broadband competition.

qa_highlights.question: Project order book conversion and margin outlook?
qa_highlights.answer: Expects about INR3,500 crores of project income in FY27 as the certain portion; project margin 4-5% with some sequential improvement in Q1. Kavach margin expected slightly better than project range.

qa_highlights.question: Reason for the exceptional item and whether it is cash?
qa_highlights.answer: The exceptional item is an ECL provision based on debtor ageing, provisional and non-cash; none of the accounts are doubtful and it can reverse on receipt of payments. Management said PBT before ECL would show growth.

qa_highlights.question: Margin trajectory of combined company given mix shift to projects?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said project margins are held at 4-5% and telecom margins are stable; the blended decline is a mix effect, and it will strive to remain in the 4-5% range.

qa_highlights.question: Data centre operational timelines and business model?
qa_highlights.answer: 10 MW Noida facility targeted by May 2027, possibly a month earlier; two edge data centres in Mumbai and Gurgaon are live, with small 500 kW additions in Hyderabad and Noida. Passive infrastructure is leased from Anant Raj, Adani and others, while RailTel provides managed/cloud services on its own servers.
